items.summary: No one is making music quite like PAINT, the project of musician and Allah-Las guitarist Pedrum Siadatian. From police blotter audio soundscapes to warbled poetry reads, fourth record Whip of an Ear is an obtusely captivating listen and one of the prolific musician's best offerings yet. items.summary: Fog lifting off San Francisco’s Victorian rooftops, twelve-string guitars catching the morning light, and the ghost of a California that exists somewhere between memory and myth.
